title: First-touch insight cards for admin onboarding: latency, token-cost, and trace snapshots
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Create a set of first-touch visual assets (static + interactive prototypes) to illustrate three compact insight cards that new admin users see when they first open Observability: 1) latency distribution sparkline + p50/p95 callout, 2) cost-per-token trend + example per-route breakdown, 3) end-to-end trace snapshot highlighting service boundaries and KV cache hits. These assets will be used in the onboarding flow, docs quickstart, and release notes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Finalized static PNGs for each card in light and dark themes (3 cards x 2 themes = 6 images).
- Interactive Figma prototype with hover states for sparkline and trace waterfall mini-expander.
- Copy approved by PM and Content for micro-explanations (<= 120 chars each).
- Engineering handoff with redlines and a small React/Storybook skeleton spec.
- Included accessibility notes for color contrast and text resize.

Scope exclusions: full dashboard redesign not in scope; deep telemetry ingestion instrumentation work belongs to ENG tickets listed in dependencies.
screenshot_variants: Latency-Sparkline-Compact_light.png: 320x180 thumbnail showing 24h sparkline, p50=120ms, p95=420ms, tooltip sample at 10:12am
Latency-Sparkline-Compact_dark.png: dark theme equivalent with focus ring on p95 callout
Cost-Per-Token-Heatmap_light.png: 480x240 heatmap of routes vs. model variants with hover card showing estimated cost per 1k tokens
Cost-Per-Token-Heatmap_dark.png: dark theme variant with reduced saturation to meet contrast
Trace-Waterfall-Snapshot_light.png: 640x300 synthesized trace highlighting latency contributors across service boundaries with KV cache hit markers
Trace-Waterfall-Snapshot_dark.png: same as above in dark theme
Trace-Expander-Interaction.mov: short prototype clip showing expand/collapse and span detail hover
design_notes: Card size balance: make each card readable in 320px width container for mobile-first onboarding modal.
Data density trade-off: show p50/p95 and a single compact histogram rather than full distribution to reduce cognitive load for new users.
Color decisions: use brand blues for latency (positive-to-warning gradient), amber for cost hotspots, and muted purple accents for trace highlights. Ensure WCAG AA contrast for text over backgrounds.
Interaction notes: hovering a heatmap cell reveals route name, sampled cost-per-token, and a link to open full cost breakdown in Console.
Fallbacks: when telemetry sample rate is low, show a skeleton illustration with CTA 'Enable richer telemetry' linking to docs.
Copy guidelines: each card has 1 headline (<=6 words), 1 subline (<=12 words), and an action (link or button) — keep tone neutral, actionable, and engineer-friendly.
